title: Insert Greatest Common Divisors in Linked List
summary: Given a linked list with integer values, insert a new node between each pair of adjacent nodes.
statement: Given a linked list with integer values, insert a new node between each pair of adjacent nodes. The new node's value is the greatest common divisor of the two adjacent nodes. Return the modified linked list.
constraints: Between every adjacent pair of original linked-list nodes, insert a new node containing their greatest common divisor.
Preserve the original node order and do not insert after the final node.
Return the head of the modified list.
hints: Save the next original node before inserting anything.
Create a node holding gcd(current.val,next.val) between current and next.
Advance to the saved original next node, not the inserted node.
Each loop processes exactly one original edge and replaces it by current→gcd→next without disturbing later edges.
editorial: Each loop processes exactly one original edge and replaces it by current→gcd→next without disturbing later edges.

tests.explanation: The inserted gcd values are six, two, and one, producing [18,6,6,2,10,1,3].
A one-node list has no adjacent pair and remains unchanged.
